Body is large, muscular, and well-proportioned with powerful legs and a long tail with a dark tuft at the end. Head is broad with a short muzzle. Ears are small, rounded, and erect. objects.taxonomy_description: Edible fungus with a characteristic cap-and-stem morphology. The cap (pileus) is convex to flat, typically 3-10 cm in diameter, with a smooth or slightly scaly surface in white, brown, or tan coloration. The underside reveals gills (lamellae) radiating from the stem, ranging from white to dark brown. The cylindrical stem (stipe) is smooth, firm, and white, typically 3-8 cm in length. The overall form is umbrella-like with a fleshy, moist texture.
